evidence.FACTS: Removed contract/policy statements: 'tarif, caution, état des lieux, assistance' as contract lines, 'le contrat prévoit-il une assistance en cas de défaillance du freinage', 'quel freinage le loueur conseille-t-il sur sa flotte du moment' (fleet), 'Pas de chiffres garantis'. Replaced by neutral questions to ask at handover (type de frein, dernière vérification, que faire si le freinage faiblit, to be specified before departure). No price, no deposit amount, no model specs or wear-limit numbers; brake behaviour is general mechanical knowledge (heat, wet, mud) phrased as tendencies. Combined braking (CBS) described only as 'levier gauche agit aussi sur l'avant'; scooter lever convention consistent with /types-motos/. No legal rule stated; permis page only linked.
evidence.INTENT: Main question: disc or drum, city vs mountain, and how to check the brakes. OWNER of 'frein à disque ou à tambour'.
